title: jq variables
description: Configuration variables for jq across POSIX, Windows native (MSVC), and MS-DOS (dos32).

JQ_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install jq. 'libscript_native' installs isolated prebuilt binaries (dos32 on MS-DOS, PE on Windows, static/prebuilt on POSIX), 'system' uses the OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

JQ_VERSION.description: Specific version of jq to install (e.g., 1.8.2 on Windows/MS-DOS or latest).

JQ_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading jq binary or archive artifacts.

JQ_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying jq available remote releases.
